# stackit_identity_groups (Data Source)

Lists STACKIT Identity groups in an organization, optionally filtered by display name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stackit_identity_groups" "group" {
  organization_id    = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  display_name_regex = ".*-admin-.*"
  sort_ascending     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) STACKIT Organization ID.

### Optional

- `display_name_regex` (String) Optional regular expression to filter groups by display name.
- `sort_ascending` (Boolean) If set to `true`, groups are sorted in ascending lexicographical order by display name. Defaults to `false` (descending).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform's internal resource ID, structured as "`organization_id`".
- `items` (Attributes List) The list of identity groups matching the provided filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the group.
- `group_id` (String) The internal UUID of the group.
